name: Thit heo hun khoi
summary: Báo Kon Tum lists thịt heo hun khói among dried foods at the weekend market. A later article names it again as a provincial 3-star OCOP product at the center stall. A visitor on the earlier article says thịt hun khói. Heo làng nướng is a different name. A price is Check on arrival.
howToEat: Báo Kon Tum names the smoked pork and does not print a smoke time or a spice list.
The visitor’s words are thịt hun khói. The dried-food list and the OCOP line say thịt heo hun khói.
A price is Check on arrival. The opening hour is Check on arrival.
where: Chợ phiên Măng Đen meets on Saturday and Sunday. The Vietnam Tourism rural portal puts the pine-hill grounds on Hùng Vương in xã Măng Đen, Quảng Ngãi. Báo Kon Tum, on that portal, puts the same pine hill on Hùng Vương in thị trấn Măng Đen, Kon Plông, and another of its articles puts the market at Vườn thông by the district central square. The opening hour is Check on arrival.
The OCOP line is a center stall, with wine products, specialty salt, smoked beef, and smoked buffalo.
seoTitle: Smoked pork in Mang Den — thịt heo hun khói
seoDescription: Thịt heo hun khói is a dried food at the Mang Den weekend market and a provincial 3-star OCOP product. A price is Check on arrival.
